## 1. What Is VentureRush Tech S.G.A Checker?
VentureRush Tech S.G.A Checker (`https://sgachecker.venturerushtech.com/`) is the #1 free SEO, AEO & GEO checker online. Anyone can enter a public website URL and click **Scan Website** to execute 224 live diagnostic checks in seconds—with no login, no paywall, and instant multi-page PDF and CSV report downloads.

Unlike legacy SEO-only checkers that ignore AI discovery, S.G.A Checker unifies three modern search visibility pillars into one dashboard with **4 live score meters**:
1. **Overall Score Meter (0–100 + Grade A+ to F)** — Weighted composite visibility score.
2. **SEO Meter (106 live checks)** — Traditional Google & Bing technical crawlability, metadata, performance, security headers, schema validation, sitemaps, and broken internal links.
3. **AEO Meter (52 live checks)** — Answer Engine Optimization readiness for Google AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, and voice assistants.
4. **GEO Meter (66 live checks)** — Generative Engine Optimization readiness for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity citations.

## 2. Detailed Breakdown of the 224 Live Checks

### Pillar 1: Free SEO Checker Online (106 Checks)
- **Meta & Headings**: `<title>` presence & optimal length (30–60 chars), meta description length (120–160 chars), H1 count & length, title-to-H1 alignment, sequential heading hierarchy, language attribute, UTF-8 charset, viewport & pinch-to-zoom accessibility, canonical self-referencing.
- **Technical & Crawlability**: Live `/robots.txt` parsing, Sitemap reference & live `/sitemap.xml` URL validation, sampled live internal link health (broken link detection), HTTP compression (gzip/brotli), Cache-Control, DOM size, render-blocking scripts, inline CSS/JS bloat, text-to-HTML ratio, font preconnect & `font-display: swap`, Web App Manifest, RSS/Atom feed, hreflang ISO validation & `x-default`.
- **Media & Accessibility**: Image ALT text presence & quality, intrinsic width/height (CLS prevention), lazy loading, modern image formats (WebP/AVIF), responsive `srcset`, ARIA landmarks (`<main>`, `<nav>`, skip link), form labels, duplicate IDs, iframe sandboxing.
- **Security & Trust**: HTTPS enforcement, mixed content, HSTS (`Strict-Transport-Security`), `Content-Security-Policy`, `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Permissions-Policy`, `rel="noopener"`, About, Contact, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Service links.
- **Social & Schema**: Full Open Graph (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `og:url`, `og:type`, `og:site_name`), Twitter/X Cards, JSON-LD syntax & required property validation, Organization logo, and schema bloat check.

### Pillar 2: Free AEO Checker Online (52 Checks)
- Server-rendered HTML word depth (ensuring AI crawlers that skip heavy JS can read your page).
- Semantic HTML5 structure, content segmentation, named entity density, definition lists (`<dl>`), data tables (`<table>`), ordered step-by-step lists (`<ol>`), and collapsible `<details>` FAQs.
- Question-style headings, Q&A blocks, answer-box-ready opening paragraphs (20–75 words), concise sentence & paragraph ratios, active voice dominance, reading level, and Table of Contents jump links.
- E-E-A-T authority score (Author byline, Organization schema, About, Contact, Legal links, HTTPS), source citations, data attribution, brand consistency, `sameAs` links, and update recency (`Last-Modified` / `dateModified`).
- Live `/robots.txt` audit for 6 core AI search crawlers (`OAI-SearchBot`, `GPTBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `Google-Extended`) and `/llms.txt` detection.

### Pillar 3: Free GEO Checker Online (66 Checks)
- Grounded in peer-reviewed Generative Engine Optimization research (Aggarwal et al., Princeton / Georgia Tech GEO study, arXiv:2311.09735), measuring statistical density, explicit source citations, authoritative outbound domains, source diversity, expert quotes, and balanced multi-perspective writing.
- Citation-ready passage structure (self-contained 100–200 word blocks opening with clear declarative definitions), first-200-word keyword prominence, topic comprehensiveness across 6 question types (What, Why, How, When, Where, Who), and `<time datetime="...">` / `<figure><figcaption>` markup.
- Knowledge Graph entity disambiguation via authoritative `sameAs` links (Wikipedia, Wikidata, LinkedIn, GitHub, YouTube), author credentials, anti-cloaking & anti-keyword-stuffing checks, boilerplate ratio, paywall/interstitial checks, live AI bot access (`GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `PerplexityBot`), and AI discovery files (`/.well-known/ai.txt`, `/ai/summary.json`, `/ai/faq.json`, `/llms-full.txt`).
